tool_input.new_string:
- name: seed_return_method
    description: "Portfolio return calculation methodology (TWR, IRR)"
    columns: *seed_columns

  - name: seed_security_master
    description: "Security master reference data - comprehensive attributes for all traded securities"
    columns:
      - name: ticker
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: security_name
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: asset_class
        tests: [not_null]
      - name: is_active
        tests: [not_null]
tool_input.old_string:
- name: seed_return_method
    description: "Portfolio return calculation methodology (TWR, IRR)"
    columns: *seed_columns
